requirements.evidence: Built single-storey half-w base (piece:0,0,0;half-w + cover). Second storey attempted but removed to free collar; no second level on final build. No valid tower of two storeys remains.

finish.summary: Single-storey half base prepared with cover; two-storey tower and drawers could not be completed due to configurator offering no drawer sockets and second storey removed due to collar clash. Honest unmet status reported.
